# Retrieval Helps Open-Domain Question Answering

## Abstract

We compare a closed-book model with a retrieval-augmented model on open-domain questions. The retrieval-augmented model reaches an answer accuracy of 71%, compared with 62% for the closed-book model. Retrieval-augmented generation improves the factual accuracy of the answers.

## Method

Both conditions use the same 7B language model. The retrieval-augmented model adds five passages from Wikipedia to the prompt.

## Results

| Condition | Answer accuracy (%) | Latency (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| Closed-book model | 62.0 | 410 |
| Retrieval-augmented model | 71.0 | 655 |

Table 1: Results on Natural Questions.

## Conclusion

Retrieval augmentation improves answer accuracy by 9 points on Natural Questions.
